description: Alt-Country Occult, also known as Gothic Americana, Occult Boho or Occultriana is a generically design aesthetic, prominent from the late 2000s through the mid-2010s that characterizes a visually, moody arresting aesthetic which perfectly combines the rugged grit of the American frontier, psychedelic themes with ritualistic, esoteric horror themes that gained emergence as an underground counter-movement to polished pop-country, mainstream heavily influencing apparel, posters, interior design and album art.
